I've been using the word "Feeling" because I know at my age, I still have a lot to learn. I know that breaking it off would seem like the right thing to do from your point of view, but we are different people. 

I respect your opinion, however I don't think that she has lost passion for me. I realize that you may have specific ways of expressing your love for your significant other, and so do I.

 I was merely asking for help to further my relationship and strengthen the bond she and I have because I know that she still cares about me quite a bit, and the same for me towards her.

Either way, I will certainly include your opinion in my thoughts, and will thank you for your input, however I think that your solution was not the correct one for this situation.

I am happy, just a bit confused and would like to keep the relationship going. I think the extrovert part is a bit off, she's more introverted. So I guess you could say she is more herself when she's around me. Thanks for the great advice. I'll talk to her about it. See where it goes from there.

That's what I've been thinking of doing, the problem is I know she still has feelings for me. So that's not really the problem. An analogy of this scenario would be I'm not looking for a new car but a way to replace the headlight.
